description: Team AgniKavach is a group of five third-year Computer Science Engineering students who came together for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We share a belief that satellite data is only useful when people can trust it and understand it. For the challenge Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots, we are combining our skills in software development, data processing and research to build SANYAM, an explainable, uncertainty-aware platform for exploring NASA active-fire observations over India.
